replies.author: IT Major Incident
replies.text:
1. As per the Windows Server Team, one of the three Domain Controllers (DC-PROD-02) is not responding to LDAP queries.
2. DNS resolution is intermittently failing because DC-PROD-02 also hosts a DNS role.
3. The remaining two DCs are overloaded handling all authentication requests.

replies.author: IT Major Incident
replies.text:
4. Windows Server Team identified that DC-PROD-02 had a corrupted NTDS.dit file after an unexpected power event.
5. DC-PROD-02 has been taken offline and DNS role transferred to DC-PROD-03.
6. Load on remaining DCs stabilized - authentication success rate back to 99%.

replies.author: IT Major Incident
replies.text:
7. All users able to authenticate successfully.
8. DC-PROD-02 will be rebuilt from backup during maintenance window.
9. Windows Team will implement UPS monitoring alerts for all DCs.

Incident ID: 3041300
Severity Level: S1
Incident Status: Resolved
Root Cause: Domain Controller NTDS.dit corruption after power event
Resolution: Offline corrupted DC, transferred DNS role, remaining DCs handling load
